target.surface: OpenAI-Realtime-compatible local server behind the existing Frankenstein 2.0 voice boundary

finding.summary: The pinned whole-response rollback protects cancelled provisional generations, but it does not cover the distinct case where the server has already completed/finalized a response while the client still has unplayed buffered audio. In that state a later barge-in can arrive after response.done: response.cancel no longer rolls back finalized chat history and conversation.item.truncate is deliberately a no-op.

confirmed_source.observation: finish_response finalizes provisional chat history when status is completed and rolls it back only for cancelled, failed or incomplete status; the rollback is inside the st.in_response branch.

handle_response_cancel delegates to finish_response(status=cancelled) and then closes pending responses. If the completed response has already cleared st.in_response, that completed chat history is not rolled back by this path.

ResponseCancelEvent computes had_response from st.in_response or st.response_pending; it still clears transport/output queues, but completed response history is already outside the provisional rollback branch.
ConversationItemTruncateEvent is accepted as a deliberate no-op because client playback is treated as owner of the unheard tail.
finalize_provisional_generation removes the response from provisional tracking, while rollback_provisional_generation only removes item/call IDs still tracked for that response key.

finding.control_flow_consequence: If server-side response completion occurs before client playout completion, the raw local speech-server Chat can contain the full finalized assistant response while the user has heard only a prefix. A later response.cancel cannot convert that finalized response back into provisional state, and truncate performs no state mutation. Source inspection therefore does not support raw server-history equivalence to the F2 heard-state boundary for this ordering.
finding.scope_fence: This is a source-proven control-flow compatibility gap and an executable runtime hypothesis. It is not runtime PRODUCT_NEGATIVE credit until the ordering is actually exercised against the bound F2 client/adapter subject.

why_existing_cancel_evidence_is_not_enou: Pinned upstream tests and source strongly support rollback for a response cancelled while it remains provisional.
Those tests do not by themselves prove the post-response.done case where server generation/TTS has completed but client playback has not.

The server explicitly delegates unheard-tail ownership to client playback while simultaneously finalizing chat history at server response completion, so server-complete and client-heard are different clocks that require a discriminator.

highest_information_discriminator.preferred_surface: lowest safe faithful VPS sandbox / clay-direct-dev through existing Trigger4 execution authority
procedure: Use the existing T7-FD-RTCOMPAT-001 semantic lane and pinned speech-to-speech revision; do not open another claim or runtime subject.
Generate a deterministic assistant response containing unique semantic markers A, B and C and enough audio to create a measurable client playback backlog.

Artificially slow or pause client playout so the server emits response.done while B/C remain unplayed; record server response.done monotonic time, received-audio boundary and actual F2 heard boundary separately.

After response.done but before client playout completion, trigger the normal F2 barge-in path and send the real response.cancel/playback-clear sequence plus conversation.item.truncate with the measured item_id/content_index/audio_end_ms.
Capture the raw speech-server Chat immediately after response.done, after response.cancel, after truncate, and the exact effective model input used for the next user turn.
Probe A/B/C independently in the next turn so heard-prefix retention and unheard-tail leakage are distinguishable.
Repeat once with WebSocket client-side buffered audio and once with WebRTC output_audio_buffer.clear semantics; preserve the transport distinction.
Repeat duplicate/stale/out-of-range truncate and a late old-turn tool result after the post-done barge-in.
Only after semantic ordering is measured, repeat in the network-blocked locality phase and record outbound inference destinations/counters.

diagnostic_matrix.architecture_consequence: HF server may remain a transport/inference organ only behind an F2-owned next-turn context reconstruction boundary.

diagnostic_matrix.next_turn_effective_context: unheard or otherwise non-commit-eligible response semantics influence generation
diagnostic_matrix.architecture_consequence: Raw HF conversation state is not drop-in compatible with the F2 heard-state contract; patch/fence/reconstruct before promotion.

diagnostic_matrix.raw_server_history: interrupted response removed or made non-influential by an executed mechanism
diagnostic_matrix.architecture_consequence: Narrow this gap only; German E2E, acoustic, locality, tool-race and Trigger4 acceptance remain separate gates.

architecture_law.f2_interrupted_output_policy: Interrupted output remains non-commit-eligible under the currently admitted F2 voice contract; raw speech-server completion must not override that authority.
architecture_law.preferred_containment_if_confirmed: Keep canonical conversation/heard-state outside the speech server and reconstruct or explicitly supply the next-turn context from F2 authority; do not create a second persona, memory, state or effect system.
architecture_law.alternate_repair: Upstream/local adapter may delay chat finalization until the client heard boundary is acknowledged or implement exact truncation semantics, but any repair requires executable regression evidence.
